title: It's super soft, but much much smaller than I'd anticipated
text: It's super soft, but much much smaller than I'd anticipated. It's super soft, but much much smaller than I'd anticipated.  Even at the discounted price (considering the original price), I felt like it ought to be bigger and much more plush, too.  Not a good deal.  $10 would have been an appropriate price.  Still debating returning it...if it'd be worth the bother/expense...and then selling it to someone local.
